decisions.reason: Locates the disabled expression, identifies busy as an unbound free identifier local to AttachButton, and explains the empty-dock early return versus the plain-phase guard-falsy branch evaluating busy and throwing ReferenceError.

Explains the render-time exception is caught by the slot error boundary which unmounts the whole dock entry, while the attach-button slot survives and the diagnostic appears only in the browser console.

Uses the shipped v0.2.10 line (context line in the diff) to establish busy pre-exists; proposes rollback/re-add plus a data-present minimal mount; flags feature.diff's imageItem placed before callback-scoped status/record as a real defect without claiming the hover diff is harmless or proving historical exposure.

Removes the dangling busy or threads it via props while preserving the phase guard; hardens arrays with record?.items ?? [] and DOM targets with event.target.closest?.(), and scopes hover lookups to where record/status are defined.

Proposes a data-present plain-phase mount test asserting chip and remove control exist with zero boundary captures; explains empty-state false green and why node --check parsing cannot catch free identifiers; includes a pre-ship gate.
